title: 18w44a Textures (FutureMC Support)
description: this mod adds old Jappa textures from 1.14 snapshot 18w44a
body:
Requies: FutureMC, Shadowfact's forgelin

this mod adds old Jappa textures from 1.14 snapshot 18w44a

I was interested in one thought: if someone doesn’t want to use the new textures from 1.14 for 1.12.2, then why did they leave the new texture for the profession blocks?

I decided to make retro profession block textures for those who want a regular, nostalgic Minecraft experience with old textures, and also so that mod backups will also contain old textures.
